fact_text: Hub Power's share price fell as Vanguard-linked selling of KSE-100 holdings hit the stock, according to the analyst.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'PSX Market Insights: Vanguard Selling KSE 100 Holdings, FTSE Russell Rating, Hubco Price Drop & More' (YouTube, 2024-07-15)

fact_text: FTSE Russell downgraded the KSE-100 rating, and the analyst linked the downgrade to Vanguard selling its index holdings.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'PSX Market Insights: Vanguard Selling KSE 100 Holdings, FTSE Russell Rating, Hubco Price Drop & More' (YouTube, 2024-07-15)

fact_text: The analyst sees no fundamental problem inside Hub Power and expects the index-driven selling to be a temporary event rather than a change in the business.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'PSX Market Insights: Vanguard Selling KSE 100 Holdings, FTSE Russell Rating, Hubco Price Drop & More' (YouTube, 2024-07-15)

fact_text: The analyst says Hub Power's dividend requirement is still in double-digit amounts, so its payouts depend on future cash flows from its power contracts, including the 2002 power purchase agreement.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'PSX Market Insights: Vanguard Selling KSE 100 Holdings, FTSE Russell Rating, Hubco Price Drop & More' (YouTube, 2024-07-15)

fact_text: The analyst considers market talk of a dividend cut at Hub Power, caused by the sale, to have little basis, but says the sale could still weigh on the stock if policy rulings go against the government.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'PSX Market Insights: Vanguard Selling KSE 100 Holdings, FTSE Russell Rating, Hubco Price Drop & More' (YouTube, 2024-07-15)

fact_text: The analyst describes the KSE-100 as consolidating around the 80,000 level in mid-July 2024, which he called healthy for the market.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'PSX Market Insights: Vanguard Selling KSE 100 Holdings, FTSE Russell Rating, Hubco Price Drop & More' (YouTube, 2024-07-15)

fact_text: The analyst's own calculation puts Engro Polymer's ethylene-to-PVC margin at about $66 per ton, down from about $400 per ton he had cited in an earlier video.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'PSX Market Insights: Vanguard Selling KSE 100 Holdings, FTSE Russell Rating, Hubco Price Drop & More' (YouTube, 2024-07-15)

fact_text: Ethylene prices fell by about $50 per ton while PVC prices held steady, which the analyst said widened the margin for Engro Polymer.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'PSX Market Insights: Vanguard Selling KSE 100 Holdings, FTSE Russell Rating, Hubco Price Drop & More' (YouTube, 2024-07-15)

fact_text: Local PVC prices rose slightly in Jodia Bazaar and the analyst saw early signs of higher sales for Engro Polymer, which he tied to summer construction activity.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'PSX Market Insights: Vanguard Selling KSE 100 Holdings, FTSE Russell Rating, Hubco Price Drop & More' (YouTube, 2024-07-15)

fact_text: Higher gas prices have hit Engro Polymer's fundamentals, though the analyst notes the company has paid dividends in profitable periods even under that pressure.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'PSX Market Insights: Vanguard Selling KSE 100 Holdings, FTSE Russell Rating, Hubco Price Drop & More' (YouTube, 2024-07-15)

fact_text: Phosphate fertilizer demand rises from July with the rice paddy season and again before the October wheat sowing, when DAP buildup normally starts.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'PSX Market Insights: Vanguard Selling KSE 100 Holdings, FTSE Russell Rating, Hubco Price Drop & More' (YouTube, 2024-07-15)

fact_text: Shortages and inefficient markets can push DAP prices up again, which the analyst cited as a reason to prefer Fauji Fertilizer Bin Qasim in this phase.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'PSX Market Insights: Vanguard Selling KSE 100 Holdings, FTSE Russell Rating, Hubco Price Drop & More' (YouTube, 2024-07-15)

fact_text: The analyst expects the policy rate to fall by about 150 basis points at the next monetary policy statement, which he sees as positive for industrial activity and equity prices.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'PSX Market Insights: Vanguard Selling KSE 100 Holdings, FTSE Russell Rating, Hubco Price Drop & More' (YouTube, 2024-07-15)

fact_text: Industrial growth was in double digits, around 11 to 12 percent, in 2020-21 but turned negative by mid-2024 as textile and large-scale manufacturing slowed.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'PSX Market Insights: Vanguard Selling KSE 100 Holdings, FTSE Russell Rating, Hubco Price Drop & More' (YouTube, 2024-07-15)

fact_text: Local SUV sales rose to 873 units in Jun 2024 from about 827 in the previous month, while total car sales were around 2,700 to 2,800 units and unit sales were lower than a year earlier.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'PSX Market Insights: Vanguard Selling KSE 100 Holdings, FTSE Russell Rating, Hubco Price Drop & More' (YouTube, 2024-07-15)

fact_text: The analyst notes that Sazgar Engineering's share price rose sharply after it outperformed the analyst's own earlier sales estimates for the auto sector.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'PSX Market Insights: Vanguard Selling KSE 100 Holdings, FTSE Russell Rating, Hubco Price Drop & More' (YouTube, 2024-07-15)

fact_text: T-bill yields eased slightly after the government's heavy borrowing, which the analyst read as a sign that rate expectations were coming down.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'PSX Market Insights: Vanguard Selling KSE 100 Holdings, FTSE Russell Rating, Hubco Price Drop & More' (YouTube, 2024-07-15)
